---
title: About
---

The "About" entry in the navbar is now marked **active**. In the
rendered HTML you'll see `class="nav-link active"` on the link.

The active marking is derived from the page's source path, not its
output href. That's deliberate: the navbar Generate transform
records the active item by source-path comparison so the same
metadata structure works across output formats. The Render step
then emits format-specific class names.
